name: What is the average cost of new window installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of new window installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of new window installation varies significantly based on several factors, including the type and material of windows (e.g., vinyl, wood, fiberglass), their size, energy efficiency features, and the complexity of the installation. It also depends on the number of windows being replaced. Generally, homeowners can expect costs to range from a few hundred to over a thousand dollars per window, including materials and labor. It's best to get a detailed quote from a contractor like City Dweller, LLC, for an accurate estimate for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: New window installation costs vary widely, typically from a few hundred to over a thousand dollars per window, depending on type, material, size, energy efficiency, and installation complexity. Obtain a detailed quote for accuracy.
